calls.title: Razor Pay & Growthbook Follow Up
calls.summary: The meeting focused on critical discussions around the current experiment volume, which is approximately 1,100 experiments monthly across about 3,000 merchants. The team anticipates scaling this number to around 10,000 with an increase to 30,000 merchants. James Shannon received preliminary approval for a new pricing structure tied to experiment volume, and a call with Anurag’s management is planned for final details. The proof of concept (POC) is set to begin after the pricing agreement, with full implementation expected by mid-April or May due to some delays. Additionally, an ongoing evaluation of build versus buy options for internal platform development was highlighted as a complex decision. Timely follow-up actions include Anurag emailing experiment numbers and scheduling a call for further pricing discussions.
calls.keywords: experiments, merchants, Proof of Concept, pricing, build versus buy, timeline
calls.action_items:
